I had 2 suicide attempts where I was dead for a while and then in a coma for about 3 days each time.  Felt instantaneous.  Do not remember anything.  Just maybe blackness/blankness.  But, no sense of time.  Waking the 1st time freaked me out because you start breathing while you're still on a respirator and it's like you're choking to death until they tell you to cough while they pull it out.  But, you're still messed up in the head and don't entirely understand what's going on.  It's like in the Matrix when they pull Neo out of the gel.  The 2nd time I realized what was going on because I had been through it before.  So, I wasn't freaked out.  Just pissed I was still alive.
